summary: Frontend-only verification of new Sales Resources article system on live preview. Verified /articles index (hero H1, hero CTA to /contact, 6 category groups, 72 article cards, working topic filters incl. Objection Handling and All), desktop nav-link-articles and mobile nav-mobile-link-articles both navigate to /articles, article pages (4 slugs) render page-article/article-h1/article-body with working breadcrumb (home->/, articles->/articles), article-related with 4 links, hero and bottom CTAs both linking to /contact. Footer contains newsletter-form and footer-link-articles->/articles, and does NOT contain broken links /how-it-works, /sales-closing-incentives, or /customer-incentive-programs. Zero console errors on /articles, home, /programs, /contact, and all 4 tested article pages. No React hydration (#418) errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Filter interaction correctly toggles group visibility via useState (verified: 1 visible group after Objection Handling filter, 6 after All).
Article routes are root-level (/<slug>) — verified all 4 sample slugs render correctly with data-testid=page-article.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://bestbuy-incentives.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified testids: nav-link-articles, nav-mobile-toggle, nav-mobile-link-articles, articles-h1, articles-hero-cta, articles-filter-all, articles-filter-objection-handling, articles-group-* (6 groups), article-card-<slug> (72 total), page-article, article-h1, article-body, article-breadcrumb, breadcrumb-home, breadcrumb-articles, article-related, article-hero-cta, article-cta, site-footer, newsletter-form, footer-link-articles. Note: mcp_browser_automation captures screenshots at 1920 width regardless of viewport, but page.set_viewport_size does apply — verify mobile behavior via window.innerWidth and DOM queries, not screenshot dims.
